headline: Affle reports 18.4% rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 130.9 crore
hook: Profit growth steady at Affle India
summary: Affle (India) reported an 18.4% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 130.9 crore for the second quarter. Brokerages including ICICI Securities and Motilal Oswal covered the quarterly performance. The results reflect continued operational performance in the company's consumer intelligence platform business. Retail investors tracking mid-cap technology and ad-tech stocks can gauge the sector's demand environment from these earnings.
why_it_matters: Affle shares react to steady mid-cap earnings growth.

headline: Affle India allots 1.27 million shares upon warrant conversion
hook: Affle equity base expands via warrant conversion
summary: Affle India has allotted 1,277,155 equity shares following the conversion of warrants. The allotment was officially confirmed by the company on October 21, 2026. This action increases the total number of outstanding equity shares for the company. Retail investors should note the resulting dilution in earnings per share.
why_it_matters: Shareholder equity is diluted by the new share issuance.

headline: Affle (India) subsidiary allots equity shares worth Rs. 28.53 crore following warrant conversion
summary: Affle 3i, a subsidiary of digital advertising firm Affle (India), has allotted equity shares amounting to Rs. 28.53 crore following the conversion of warrants. Such conversions increase the paid-up capital of the company and result in dilution for existing shareholders. While a routine corporate action, this reflects capital infusion into the subsidiary entity. Indian retail investors tracking the parent company should note the change in share capital structure.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary capital expansion slightly dilutes equity.

headline: Supreme Court grants stay on NCLT insolvency proceedings against Bobble
hook: Supreme Court pauses Bobble insolvency proceedings
summary: Affle 3i Limited informed the exchange that the Supreme Court of India has granted a stay order on the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) proceedings of Bobble pending before the NCLT. Bobble's insolvency had been moving through tribunal channels. The pause protects the status quo of the company while the legal challenge proceeds in the apex court. Indian retail investors tracking Affle's subsidiaries and legal liabilities should note this judicial intervention.
whats_next: Supreme Court hearings on the Bobble insolvency matter
why_it_matters: Subsidiary legal status pauses, easing immediate insolvency uncertainty for Affle.

headline: Affle Holdings exercises warrant conversion into equity shares
hook: Promoter converts warrants into equity shares
summary: Affle (India) announced that its promoter, Affle Holdings Pte. Ltd., has submitted an exercise request to convert warrants into equity shares. This corporate action changes the promoter shareholding structure in the listed entity. Such conversions typically reflect promoter confidence in the underlying business. Indian retail investors tracking insider activity should note potential equity dilution.
why_it_matters: Promoter stake adjustments can alter voting power and equity dilution.
